project_type: AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript) demo for DVA-C03 Security & Observability: CloudFront + regional WAF + API Gateway REST + Python 3.12 Lambdas (one container-image assistant running Strands Agents + Bedrock Nova Micro behind a Guardrail over PrivateLink; two plain-zip boto3 Lambdas) + DynamoDB (CMK) + KMS + S3 + Secrets Manager + SSM, plus a dependency-light vanilla JS/CSS SPA.
language: Python 3.12 (Lambdas, pure-logic unit tests), TypeScript (CDK infra), vanilla JS/HTML/CSS (SPA), bash (deploy/destroy).
build_system: CDK via npm in infra/ (aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0). Assistant Lambda is a container image published to a DEDICATED ECR repo 'session5-secure-assistant' by deploy.sh (NOT a CDK image asset) because local buildx emits an OCI index Lambda rejects; the app-edge stack imports the repo by name and references the :latest tag. The two zip Lambdas ship via lambda.Code.fromAsset. QUIRK: assistant code changes require a manual docker buildx build+push BEFORE cdk deploy, then confirm the Lambda rolled to the new digest.
test_framework: Python: pytest 8.3.2 (dev-requirements.txt), strands-free + boto3-free, injected table/s3 stubs; app/tests/conftest.py adds app/ to sys.path so each Lambda imports as a package. Infra: a hand-rolled assert harness run via ts-node (test/template.test.ts), NOT jest. No JS test runner for the SPA.
build_command: Python compile: python3 -m py_compile $(find app -name '*.py'). Infra typecheck: (cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit). Infra synth: (cd infra && npx cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData) / (... SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI).
test_command: Python: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q (run from the demo root; baseline 16 passed). Infra: (cd infra && npm test).

contribution_requirements: Follow README.md 'Local verification' commands. Keep Python Lambda code importable WITHOUT strands/boto3 (guarded imports): tools.py @tool degrades to identity; handlers guard boto3/aws_xray imports. All PII masked/validated in the tool layer (pii.py) BEFORE any DynamoDB write or log (the Guardrail does NOT see tool-call args/results). No model-id change; no weakening of Guardrail/WAF/KMS/PrivateLink/TLS. SPA calls are same-origin relative /api/... only. Do NOT broaden the assistant IAM role. HARD INVARIANTS are enumerated per-feature.
key_patterns: Factory tools: make_initiate_refund(table, req_ctx, max_refund) returns an @tool bound to an injected DynamoDB Table-like object + a request-scoped side-channel dict; the HTTP envelope reads ids from req_ctx (NEVER parsed from model text). pii.py: pure validate_order_id (^ORD-[0-9]{6}$), validate_amount, mask_pii. Zip Lambdas (presign/refund_confirm): guarded boto3 import, guarded aws_xray patch_all, pure injectable core + thin handler, _response(status, body) JSON envelope, empty __init__.py package marker. session4 status_for(created_at, now) pattern = status derived from age at read time (no worker). boto3 resource Table needs Decimal for Number attributes; readers coerce float before JSON. Fixed menu prices come from spa/index.html: Flat White 4.50, Latte 4.75, Croissant 3.00, Coco Cake 5.25.
